benchmarkDenominator.runnerStatus: not full pass parity. Bounded runner evidence remains recorded for gix-object, gix-actor, gix-ref, gix-validate, gix-transport redirect, gix-credentials, gix-pack thin-pack/input-output traversal, and gix-merge package integration; recent gix-merge bounded evidence passed 23/23 integration tests with 0 failures as part of a clean 148-test local package group. The latest PHP slice statically maps upstream built-in merge-driver selection where `text`, `binary`, and `union` names are case-sensitive, `merge`/`-merge`/`!merge` attributes select text/binary/default drivers, unknown built-ins fall back to text when no custom driver is registered, and `conflict-marker-size` accepts only non-zero u8 values. Targeted source reads counted 36 focused BuiltinDriver/DriverChoice/merge.default/marker-size references across 4 selected source/test paths plus 10 platform test attributes. A new upstream Cargo run was not attempted for this narrow selection boundary because the behavior is directly source/test-level and prior bounded gix-merge evidence already covers the package target. Focused gitoxide PHP verification passes 31 files, 2448 assertions, and 0 failures. Required root verification passes with 172 test files, 16025 assertions, and 0 failures. Full workspace cargo test was not executed because it would hydrate and build the large feature-heavy workspace beyond the current VM cap.

Focused gix-pack thin-pack repair inventory: selected bundle/input/output source and input paths; upstream data::input::lookup_ref_delta_objects passed 4/4 filtered tests; native thin-pack repair behavior is mapped. Current examples cover deploy-tree inspection, ref parsing/classification, protocol fetch/push flows, pack/object database traversal, partial clone/promisor hydration, sparse checkout, recursive tree/blob merges, blob merge auto-resolution for local deployment policy, zealous-diff3 theme conflict presentation from the upstream `zdiff3` config literal, anonymous unlabeled editor diff3 previews, union block notes, `.gitattributes` built-in merge-driver selection for block notes/media/theme JSON, blank-line block-spacing false-conflict suppression, mixed-line-ending block conflict markers, shared block-refactor partial-match conflict contraction, index/worktree conflict materialization, transport boundaries, annotated release-tag provenance, credential helper context/cascade/program preflight, credential prompt fallback, thin WordPress content-pack repair using an existing base blob without invoking git index-pack, bounded delta-base search for large WordPress export packs that should avoid spending work on old bases when recent scratch blobs do not help, and existing-pack repacks that copy compressed WordPress export objects, emit explicit thin transit packs when a receiver already has the base object, or normalize legacy in-pack REF_DELTA export packs into complete resting packs.
